name: Petuel
title: The father of the prophet Joel
summary: Petuel is known from the Bible exclusively as the father of the prophet Joel. He is mentioned in the opening verse of the book of Joel, where Joel identifies himself as "son of Petuel." Beyond this, there are no further biographical details about him in Scripture.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Joel's father
keyEvents.description: Petuel is mentioned in the opening verse of the book of Joel as the father of the prophet Joel. This is the only reference to him in the entire Bible.

keyEvents.title: Joel's prophetic call
keyEvents.description: The word of the Lord came to Joel, son of Petuel, indicating that Joel received his prophetic calling from God. As Joel's father, Petuel may have played a role in shaping the future prophet.

keyEvents.title: Joel's prophecy about the outpouring of the Spirit
keyEvents.description: Joel's most famous prophecy concerns the outpouring of God's Spirit on all flesh, a prophecy that was fulfilled on the day of Pentecost. As Joel's father, Petuel is indirectly connected to this important prophetic tradition.

keyEvents.title: Peter quotes Joel, son of Petuel, on the day of Pentecost
keyEvents.description: The apostle Peter quoted the prophet Joel, son of Petuel, in his speech on the day of Pentecost to explain the miraculous outpouring of the Holy Spirit.
